fusions.name: Twist the Blade
fusions.desc: Twists a blade into a target carrying one of your afflictions, using it up to deal 9 damage and leave the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Pinwheel Flurry
fusions.desc: Flings 4 spinning knives in a spread, each dealing 25 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Grindstone Edge
fusions.desc: Increases your slashing damage by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Edge Comes Round
fusions.desc: Every critical hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (136% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
